digest.component_or_area: pytest hang budget / CI test timeout configuration
propositions: The per-test hang budget was lowered from 300s to 20s in commit 6a5c88027c5 while legitimate whole-tree-scan tests cost 18.7–29.93s on covered CI legs, causing ~11–14 xdist worker deaths per run with zero 'Failed: Timeout' verdicts.

The timeout_method=thread setting kills workers via os._exit(1) rather than pytest.fail(), so budget expiries inside xdist workers never produce a timeout verdict — only 'node down' and 'worker crashed' messages.

A workflow-text fix to the budget (changing _build-and-test.yml flags or pyproject.toml ini) fails its own Verified gate because the gate executes workflow files from trusted main, not the patchset, so the stale CLI flag overrides the patchset's ini value (pytest-timeout precedence CLI > INI).

The fix restores timeout=300 in both pyproject.toml:662 and both _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes' explicit --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread flags, with headroom contract tests assigning budget >= 2x the measured 29.93s worst case and <= 600s.

Dead workers under --dist loadgroup re-dispatch pending items including the crashing test to respawned workers that die on the same item, burning up to numprocesses*4 restarts before reaching a terminal state or job timeout.
Post-merge Verified runs on main at commit a42a9d8d494 show zero worker-crash signatures where every pre-fix run on 6a5c88027c5 reported 11–14 worker deaths per run.
